names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 3 noiembrie, «Sfântul Mucenic Achepsima, episcopul».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 3 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιοι Ακεψιμάς, Ιωσήφ και Αειθαλάς», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 3 ноября ст. ст., «Святитель Акепсим Наессонский (Анисский), Арбельский, Персидский, епископ, сщмч.», with the rank words at both ends left off. The line itself gives «Акепсима», the genitive, with «еп.» for the grade and no by-name at all.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 3. новембар ст. ст., „Свешт. муч. Акепсим еп. Наесонски и други с њим.“ — «Свешт. муч.» is the `hieromartyr` grade `types` keeps, «еп.» the `bishop`, and «Наесонски» is the complement of «еп.», the see it governs, so it comes off with the rank: the same reading as «еп. Патавски» on the Julian 2 November and as `andrew-of-crete`’s «архиеп. Критски». The see is already in this folder’s `office`. `sr-foldpred.mjs` measured «Акепсим» at 0 other holders, which is worth saying because the corpus holds five more men of this name — `acepsimas-3-november` on this very day, `akepsimas-29-january`, `akepsimas-martyr-7-december`, `akepsimas-martyr-11-december` and `akepsees-of-arbela` — and none of them stores a Cyrillic Акепсим standing alone.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 3 ноября ст. ст. — «Мчч. Акепсима еп., Иосифа пресвитера и Аифала диакона (IV).»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Ακεψιμάς, Ιωσήφ και Αειθαλάς»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the man is the folder's own: «Ο Άγιος Ακεψιμάς ήταν επίσκοπος», martyred under Shapur II. A `dates` object is proposed from the page's «περί το 330 μ.Χ.» where the folder had none. The entry enumerates three men: Joseph is an upgrade in this same file, and Aithalas is reported and not touched because his folder already carries a venerated Greek row on 2 September. **The same day's listing keeps a second Acepsimas**, a hermit of the fourth century who died in peace, who is a new folder of this batch and not this bishop. The apolytikion names all three and is taken; the kontakion names this Acepsimas «σὺν τοῖς συνάθλοις σου» and is taken into his folder only; the page's «Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον» is the common of martyrs, «Οἱ Μάρτυρές σου, Κύριε», and the Κάθισμα is neither a troparion nor a kontakion, and neither is drafted. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 16.11.2025 (3. новембар ст. ст.) — „Свешт. муч. Акепсим еп. Наесонски и други с њим.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, eleven sentences, and the FIRST NARRATIVE LIFE this folder has had: the Greek notice gave it a reign and the Romanian and Russian lines a company. Quoted whole with its closing full stop (section 4); URL year 2025, as `sr-civil.mjs` gives for the Julian 10-20 to 12-18. THE HEADING NAMES ONE MAN AND CLOSES «и други с њим», others with him, WHICH ENUMERATES NOBODY — so section 5 gives ONE row, and the two companions the BODY names take none: «сутрадан буду доведени и Јосиф, презвитер и старац од 70 година, и Аитал ђакон» — Joseph a presbyter and an old man of seventy, and Aithalas a deacon, who are `joseph-presbyter-of-persia` and `aithalas-the-deacon`, both held by this corpus, both `related` here in both directions, and both refused a serbian row because the heading does not name them. THAT IS THE THIRD TIME IN THREE DAYS. Theodotia on 1 November and the twenty-eight soldiers and the emperor’s mother on 2 November were the same shape, and so is this. AUTHOR: a ruling on whether a person the BODY names and the HEADING does not may ever take a row would settle every day of this book; at present the answer taken is no, and it is costing rows the other three calendars already carry. `types` and `office` UNTOUCHED and the heading confirms both: «Свешт. муч.» is the `hieromartyr`, «еп.» the `bishop`, and «Наесонски» is the see already in `office` as Bishop of Naeson in Persia. `dates` UNTOUCHED at «about 330»: the entry closes «Пострадаше ови Христови војници у IV веку, у Персији, а за време незнабожног цара Саворија» — in the fourth century, in Persia, in the time of the heathen king Shapur — which contains the Greek page’s «περί το 330» and adds no number, so there is nothing to widen. NO `locations`: Persia is the whole of the geography and no city is named. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS, AND IT IS THE WHOLE OF A STORY NO OTHER PAGE READ FOR THIS FOLDER CARRIES: he was an old man of eighty, full of every Christian virtue; a child filled with the grace of the Spirit of God ran up to him at his own table and kissed him on the head, saying „Благо овој глави, јер ће за Христа примити мучење!“ — blessed is this head, for it shall receive martyrdom for Christ — and the prophecy was soon fulfilled; when he was bound and one of his household asked what he commanded concerning the house, he answered „То више није дом мој, ја бесповратно одлазим у дом вишњи.“ — this is no longer my house, I am going beyond return to the house on high; and after THREE YEARS in prison and many torments his head was struck off. AND THE BOOK’S TWO COMPANION DEATHS ARE RECORDED HERE EVEN THOUGH NEITHER MAN TAKES A ROW: the two were buried to the thighs in the earth and Christians were ordered to strike them with stones; Joseph’s body vanished that night by the Providence of God, and over Aithalas’s body grew a tree called «марсина» which healed every disease and every torment in men for five years, until the malicious and envious heathen cut it down. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: doxologia.ro, Troparul Sfinților Sfințiți Mucenici Achepsima episcopul, Iosif preotul și Aitala diaconul, Glasul 4

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contests received incorruptible crowns from Thee our God; for possessing Thy strength they overthrew their torturers, and broke the feeble daring of the demons. By their prayers save Thou our souls, O Christ God.

hymns.text: Ὡς θεράποντες, τῆς εὐσέβειας, στῦλοι ὤφθητε, τῆς Ἐκκλησίας, πυρσολατρῶν καθελόντες τὸ φρύαγμα, Ἀκεψιμᾶ Ἱεράρχα πολύαθλε, Ἀειθαλᾶ Ἰωσὴφ τὲ μακάριοι. Ἀλλ' αἰτήσασθε, Χριστὸν τὸν Θεὸν πανεύφημοι, δωρήσασθαι ἠμὶν τὸ μέγα ἔλεος.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος γ’, Θείας πίστεως — the first hymn on the page of «Άγιοι Ακεψιμάς, Ιωσήφ και Αειθαλάς». It names all three of them and no other saint, and calls this Acepsimas Ἱεράρχα. The page's second apolytikion is the common of martyrs and is not taken.

english.text: As servants of godliness you were shown to be pillars of the Church, pulling down the arrogance of the fire-worshippers — Acepsimas the much-contending hierarch, and blessed Aithalas and Joseph. All-praised ones, ask Christ our God to grant us his great mercy.

hymns.text: Τὰ θεῖα σοφέ, σεπτῶς ἐμυσταγώγησας, θυσία δεκτὴ ἐγένου Παμμακάριστε· τοῦ Χριστοῦ γὰρ ἔπιες, τὸ ποτήριον ἐνδόξως Ἅγιε, Ἀκεψιμᾶ σὺν τοῖς συνάθλοις σου, πρεσβεύων ἀπαύστως ὑπὲρ πάντων ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β’, Τὰ ἄνω ζητῶν — on the page of «Άγιοι Ακεψιμάς, Ιωσήφ και Αειθαλάς». It names him alone and calls his companions only «τοῖς συνάθλοις σου», so it is taken into his folder and not into theirs.

english.text: You brought men reverently into the divine mysteries, wise one, and became an acceptable sacrifice, all-blessed; for you drank the cup of Christ gloriously, holy Acepsimas, with your fellow contenders, interceding without ceasing for us all.

hymns.text: Мученицы Твои, Господи,/ во страданиих своих венцы прияша нетленныя от Тебе, Бога нашего,/ имуще бо крепость Твою,/ мучителей низложиша,/ сокрушиша и демонов немощныя дерзости:/ тех молитвами// спаси души наша.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 3 ноября ст. ст. — «Тропарь мучеников». The text names none of the three and is the common of martyrs, printed under their line and copied whole, as the brief directs; it is the Slavonic of the troparion this folder already holds in Romanian, and not the Greek one, which calls the three of them pillars of the Church.

english.text: Your martyrs, O Lord, in their sufferings received incorruptible crowns from you, our God; for having your strength they cast down the tormentors and shattered the feeble insolence of the demons. By their prayers save our souls.

hymns.text: Божественная, мудре, непорочно тайноводил еси,/ жертва приятна был еси, богоблаженне,/ Христову бо пил еси чашу славно, святе Акепсимо,/ со страдальцы твоими,// моляся непрестанно о всех нас.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 3 ноября ст. ст. — «Кондак мучеников». It names him and his fellow-sufferers and no other saint, and it is the Slavonic of the kontakion this folder already holds in Greek. It is taken for this folder only, as the Greek one was, because it is the one of the three the text names.

english.text: Wisely and blamelessly you were led into the divine mysteries, and became an acceptable sacrifice, O God-blessed one; for gloriously you drank the cup of Christ, holy Acepsimas, together with your fellow-sufferers, praying without ceasing for us all.

death.note: saint.gr: «Και οι τρεις μαρτύρησαν για το Χριστό, όταν βασιλιάς της Περσίας ήταν ο Σαπώρ ο Β' (περί το 330 μ.Χ.)» — the page's own year, written «περί», about, for the reign it sets the martyrdom in. No year of birth is given.
